title: Ontario permit-to-start-to-completion conversion evidence
question: Which permit intentions become starts, completions, and occupancy?
why_it_matters: Building permits are upstream intentions. FTFN needs conversion evidence to know whether approvals become starts, completions, occupied units, or stalled projects.
current_support: FTFN has Statistics Canada building permits, CMHC housing market portal data, and CMHC starts, completions, and units-under-construction tables.
next_action: Add municipal completion, servicing, financing, and geography-specific conversion evidence.
notes: CMHC starts/completions improve the conversion lens but do not prove local project outcomes.
